meta.endpoint: paired ceiling-normalised R@20, T − C, n=133, under gemma@768
meta.late_chunking_asymmetry: qwen3@1024 ranks the STORED dense_1024 vectors (produced with late chunking); gemma@768 embeds the chunk text directly. Same asymmetry §I63/§I70 carried.
meta.preregistered_rule: attributable iff the 95 % CI excludes 0; otherwise the honest statement is a RESULT of no movement, not an unresolved one
meta.what: §I71 arm 1 — isolates the CONTENT-FILTER STATE: does applying the CURRENT `content_filter.is_content()` to the shipped pool move base-lane PAGE ranking? Same stored vectors, same queries, same metric code; the pool filter is the only variable.
meta.why_no_reingest: the filter changes which chunks are in the candidate pool, not any chunk's text, id or vector — so it is measurable over the vectors already stored (pre-reg §2)
